tagline: Before you rebuild it, find out what's actually wrong.

positioning.ideal_buyer: Owners of an existing website, workflow, app or other digital or operational asset
positioning.buyer_problem: An asset exists but its next useful fix or opportunity is unclear.
positioning.intended_outcome: A focused diagnosis of one defined asset or workflow

delivery_contract.deliverable_to_scope: A written diagnostic summary identifying observed issues, evidence limits and practical next actions for the agreed asset
delivery_contract.buyer_inputs: One asset URL or description, proof of authorized access, business goal, observed issue and supporting non-sensitive material
delivery_contract.acceptance_criteria_to_agree: Named asset, bounded questions, evidence available, written findings and agreed review date
delivery_contract.exclusions: No full rebuild, unapproved production access, guaranteed commercial lift or forensic certification

discovery_intents: why is my business website not converting
acquisition.content_angle: A good repair starts with knowing what needs repair.
acquisition.approved_example_copy: Before spending money rebuilding an app, website or business workflow, get a scoped $149 Asset Diagnosis. Evercraft reviews one agreed asset and provides written findings and next steps after scope confirmation.
acquisition.distribution_rule: Use owned or authorized channels and qualified, permissioned audiences only. Do not claim posts, leads, conversion or revenue without source receipts.

evercraft_os.relationship: Independent market-facing product, sharing future Evercraft OS capabilities
evercraft_os.module_context: Evercraft OS / Asset intelligence (shared architecture, not proof of deployed integration)

launch_evidence: Existing exact-price Stripe service page tested historically, with owner-shared buyer-view screenshots. This is not a new live purchase or automated delivery attestation.

identity.signature_phrase: See it clearly before changing it.
identity.purpose: Reveal what is actually happening inside one asset before the owner spends on the wrong fix.
identity.narrative_promise: Evidence should come before expensive changes.
